subject.title: [Feature]:   Add configurable send hotkey for WebChat (Cmd+Enter instead of Enter)

question: Should WebChat get a configurable send-shortcut preference, and should that preference live in browser-local UI settings, gateway/openclaw.json config, or both?
rationale: The requested behavior is useful but changes a user-visible composer contract and may add config/settings surface, so the exact persistence and default behavior need maintainer product intent.

options.title: Review the linked PR path
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/73390 as the implementation candidate after resolving conflicts and requiring compatibility-preserving defaults plus Enter, Shift+Enter, IME, and Cmd/Ctrl+Enter tests.

options.title: Limit to browser-local preference
options.body: Accept a UI-local persisted setting and avoid adding retired WebChat gateway/openclaw.json config unless maintainers want centralized operator policy.

options.title: Decline the shortcut setting
options.body: Close the linked PR and this issue as not planned, keeping plain Enter-to-send plus Shift+Enter newline as the WebChat contract.

recommendation.title: Review the linked PR path
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/73390 as the implementation candidate after resolving conflicts and requiring compatibility-preserving defaults plus Enter, Shift+Enter, IME, and Cmd/Ctrl+Enter tests.

likelyOwner.reason: They wrote the prior review and have recent history across the current chat/settings surface.
